name: chat_resource
reportModel:
<#list data as item>

编号：${item.show_identifier!''}

标题：${item.title!''}

负责人：${item.maintenance_name!''}

<#if item.state_text??>
状态：${item.state_text!''}
</#if>
 
<#if item.level_text??>
重要程度：${item.level_text!''}
</#if>


<#if item.precondition??>
前置条件：${utils.html2md(item.precondition!"")}
</#if>
 
 <#if item.steps??>
    <#assign steps = item.steps.getReal()>
    <#if steps?has_content>
    步骤列表：
        <#if steps?is_sequence>
            <#list steps as step>
                    <#if step.is_group?? && step.is_group == 1>
                        分组：${step.name!""}
                    </#if>
                    步骤描述：${step.description!""}  预期结果：${step.expected_value!""}
            </#list>
        </#if>
    </#if>
</#if>


 <#if item.description??>
描述：${utils.html2md(item.description!"")}
</#if>


<#assign comments = api.invoke("/test_cases/"+item.id+"/comments/fetch_default",'{"n_owner_type_eq":"TEST_CASE","n_principal_id_eq":"'+item.id+'","page":0,"size":1000}') >
<#if comments?has_content>
评论
	<#list comments as comment>
	${comment.create_man!""}于${comment.create_time!""}发表
		<#if comment.pcontent??>
		> ${comment.pcontent}
		</#if>
		${utils.html2md(comment.content!"")}
	</#list>
</#if>

</#list>
